images.title: Direction 3: three people
images.prompt:
STYLE - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART. A screenshot of LOW-POLYGON 3D characters whose surfaces are PAINTED WITH VISIBLE BRUSHWORK:
- GEOMETRY: simple, from a few large flat planes; polygon edges show in the silhouettes (angular shoulders and elbows, a faceted hat brim, straight-segment coat hems, simple block hands). Heads are simple with a modest nose ridge; no sculpted wrinkles or modelled folds.
- TEXTURES: painted with visible brush strokes and broad colour patches, like an oil sketch, in the manner of the painterly animated series Arcane. Folds, seams, buttons, hair, wrinkles, eyes and mouths are painted on with a few confident strokes. Painted shading is soft, so the scene's real warm light still shapes the forms.
- FACES: painted, simplified planes; characterful, gently exaggerated features (strong jaw, big working hands) but grounded.
- Crisp modern resolution, NOT pixelated, NOT a PS1 emulation.
NOT photoreal, NOT realistic skin pores, NOT photographic fabric, NOT a high-poly sculpt, NOT cinematic CGI, NOT anime, NOT a cartoon.

WHAT IT IS: a screenshot from a game's character viewer: three 3D game characters standing side by side, full body head to boots, relaxed natural standing poses, three-quarter front view, at eye level, on a plain flat warm-grey floor and backdrop. Landscape aspect about 1536x1024. Equal spacing; each person fills most of the height.

THE THREE PEOPLE (keep them recognisably the same people):
- THE INNKEEPER: a sturdy, warm woman in her late forties; broad shoulders, strong forearms, sleeves rolled; dark hair pinned up with loose strands; plain linen blouse, faded madder-red skirt, long work apron, a ring of keys at her belt; kind, tired, amused eyes.
- THE PROVISIONER: a lean, older man around sixty; slightly stooped; close grey beard; small round spectacles; muted teal waistcoat over a shirt, a pencil behind his ear, a worn ledger under one arm; dry, careful expression.
- THE FELLOW EXPLORER: a weathered traveller in their late twenties; sun-darkened skin; a long oiled-canvas travel coat, practical boots and gaiters, a wide-brimmed hat, a rolled bedroll and a brass compass case on a strap, a long flintlock rifle slung on the back; alert, friendly, a little worn out.

SETTING AND ERA: a warm early-modern frontier fantasy world (roughly 17th-18th century European clothing, common gunpowder, practical expedition gear). NOT medieval knights, NOT heavy fantasy armour, NOT steampunk. Palette family: warm ochres and plaster, sun-faded reds, softened teal and green, worn leather browns, cooler distance.

PROHIBITIONS: NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO UI, NO watermark, NO frame or collage. NOT anime, NOT chibi, NOT toon outlines or cel shading (unless the style says so), NOT photoreal film still.

rejected_lessons: A prompt that asks for '3D game characters' without a forceful STYLE block first falls back to near-photoreal mid-budget realism (the whole first pass of #10027).
Asking for 'low-polygon' brings triangle-faceted polygon art; say smooth-shaded, angular only in silhouettes.
A 'centre' prompt between storybook and realism slid back to near-photoreal (bracket C): the painting has to be stated strongly.
